column1: # The committed slice-quality tier RATCHET FLOOR: the minimum tier each opted-in
# slice's manifest may declare. A slice's `gmeow:sliceQualityTier` may be RAISED
# above its floor freely; lowering the manifest declaration below the floor recorded
# here fails `make slice-quality-gate`. Raising a floor is a deliberate, reviewed
# commit that pins the new guarantee. Format: <slice-iri>\t<tier-local-name>.
